messages:
maria (Design): Quick pass on Console header/nav contrast — the collapsed nav labels are currently #5c6b7a on #ffffff and fail WCAG at 14px. Can we move to a darker token or increase weight? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/console-shell

sam (Eng-Frontend): Re: color — bolding will shift layout in the compact nav. Prefer changing color only. If we pick a new hex, I can push as a theme token.

liam (PM): Try to keep changes scoped for this cycle. If it's a large style swap we should target admin pages first.

maria (Design): Agreed. Proposal: scope to /console/admin and /console/billing for this rollout. Also found keyboard focus smell — currently we remove native outline and fall back to a 1px blue line that is barely visible at 2x. Suggest switching to a more visible focus-visible ring and avoid outline: none.

sam (Eng-Frontend): Can you propose exact CSS? I can implement. Avoid layout shifts.

maria (Design): CSS suggestion (for handoff):
```css
.left-nav a:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px dashed #FFB84D; /* warm amber for contrast */
  outline-offset: 2px;
  background-color: rgba(255,184,77,0.06);
}
```
Use :focus-visible so mouse clicks don't show the ring.

jen (QA): Heads up — the collapse/expand control for the nav doesn't toggle aria-expanded right now. VoiceOver reads it as a plain link. That will confuse keyboard and screen-reader users.

maria (Design): Thanks Jen — I'll add annotation to the component: role="button" and manage aria-expanded state with the collapse control. Also add visually-hidden text for screen readers when labels are hidden.

sam (Eng-Frontend): Will add JS toggle and aria-expanded. Quick lint output: a11y-linter flagged the current header contrast for 14px as 3.2:1. Target should be >=4.5:1 for normal text. The recommended color that passes is #243b52 (4.6:1) or we can bump type to 15/16px.

liam (PM): If changing font-size affects rhythm, prefer color change. Keep line-heights unchanged.

maria (Design): I'll update Figma tokens to use --nav-text-dark: #243b52 for admin/night combos and add a note to the release docs. Also attaching quick screen-reader checklist: 1) collapse button has aria-expanded and aria-controls 2) hidden labels have sr-only spans 3) nav groups have aria-labels 4) focus order consistent when collapsed 5) test with VoiceOver + NVDA.

sam (Eng-Frontend): I'll send a PR with the CSS and a small JS change. Leaving comments in PR for QA to run SR pass.

jen (QA): I'll do a VoiceOver pass on macOS and NVDA on Windows once PR is up. Also will add an automated test that asserts aria-expanded toggles and focusable elements are reachable by keyboard (tab sequence).

maria (Design): Small follow-ups: 1) update color tokens in Figma 2) add :focus-visible styles to components 3) ensure the collapse control has semantic role + aria 4) add a note to the a11y section in the release checklist. Tagging @sam for implementation.

sam (Eng-Frontend): Ack — aiming to land before EOD. :thumbsup:

liam (PM): Nice and pragmatic. Thanks team.

a11y-bot: automated-check: staging /console/nav — 2 failures (contrast, missing aria-expanded). Regression test added to a11y-ci.

maria (Design): Thanks bot — I'll update the design notes and include the corrected tokens.
